title: D2P Unit
description: Physical unit identifier used by D2P documents. Canonical domain units are millimetres (length) and radians (angle); 'm' and 'deg' are permitted only where a schema explicitly allows them at an import/export boundary and must be converted explicitly. The root of this schema accepts any supported unit; use the $defs for narrower contexts.
$comment: Extended for standard 1.0. All 1.0 documents use canonical units only; no 1.0 document schema references the root or the 'unit', 'lengthUnit' or 'angleUnit' definitions, so 'm' and 'deg' stay reserved for later import/export boundary schemas.

canonicalLengthUnit.title: Canonical length unit
canonicalLengthUnit.description: The only length unit permitted inside evaluated domain data (e.g. geometry snapshots).

canonicalAngleUnit.title: Canonical angle unit
canonicalAngleUnit.description: The only angle unit permitted inside evaluated domain data (e.g. geometry snapshots).

lengthMm.title: Length in mm
lengthMm.description: Length in millimetres as a bare number (may be negative, e.g. a coordinate or a signed offset).

nonNegativeLengthMm.title: Non-negative length in mm
nonNegativeLengthMm.description: Length in millimetres, greater than or equal to 0.

positiveLengthMm.title: Positive length in mm
positiveLengthMm.description: Length in millimetres, strictly greater than 0.

angleRad.title: Angle in rad
angleRad.description: Angle in radians as a bare number.

dimension.title: Dimension
dimension.description: Physical dimension of a value: length (mm), angle (rad) or dimensionless.

quantityUnit.title: Quantity unit
quantityUnit.description: Canonical unit of a quantity: 'mm' (length), 'rad' (angle) or '1' (dimensionless).

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Value with an explicit canonical unit, used where a value is entered or transported as a measurement and for expression literals.

value.description: Numeric value in the given unit.

lengthQuantity.title: Length quantity
lengthQuantity.description: Quantity whose unit is fixed to millimetres.

angleQuantity.title: Angle quantity
angleQuantity.description: Quantity whose unit is fixed to radians.

unitsDeclaration.title: Units declaration
unitsDeclaration.description: Explicit declaration of the canonical units used by a document: millimetres for length and radians for angle.
